properties.name: foundgine.mcp.enabled
properties.description: Expose the MCP server (read tools). Needs a host ISecurityExecutionContextProvider.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.allowed-origins
properties.description: Origins accepted in the Origin header; a request without one is accepted.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.session-idle-minutes
properties.description: Minutes of inactivity before a session expires.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.session-max-lifetime-minutes
properties.description: Maximum lifetime of a session in minutes.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-enabled
properties.description: Enable server-to-client SSE (GET) with replay buffers. Needs sessions-enabled.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-max-streams
properties.description: Maximum sessions with a replay buffer.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-max-events
properties.description: Replay buffer size per session, in events.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-max-bytes
properties.description: Replay buffer size per session, in bytes.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-heartbeat-seconds
properties.description: Interval of the heartbeat comment that keeps idle streams open.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-max-stream-seconds
properties.description: A stream older than this is ended so the client reconnects with Last-Event-ID; 0 = no limit.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-sweep-seconds
properties.description: Interval of the sweep that purges expired sessions and drops their buffers.

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-max-open-streams
properties.description: Maximum concurrently open SSE streams (429 beyond).

properties.name: foundgine.mcp.sse-max-streams-per-principal
properties.description: Maximum concurrently open SSE streams per authenticated principal (429 beyond).
